Q7 FAIL -- the signed network adds +0.0043 over its linear twin, against a 0.005 bar
Q8 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
OmniPath is a literature aggregation: coverage tracks how much a gene has been
published on, so a coverage-driven result can look like a mechanism.
The readout is CRISPRi in K562 at one timepoint. Two hops of propagation may not
have happened by then, which would penalise C4 for assay timing, not structure.
An OmniPath sign is a consensus across sources and contexts. This tests the
consensus sign, not a K562-specific sign.
8,175 of 8,248 genes and 8,917 of 11,258 rows survive screening; nothing here
speaks for what was dropped.
